description: Cross-country ski trail system that inter-connects with Regional district trails.
directions: In Blue River from Southern Yellowhead Hwy 5, turn east onto Angus Horne Street. Proceed 1.1km and turn east again onto Herb Bilton Way to cross the railroad tracks. Continue up Herb Bilton Way approximately 800m to the trailhead area.
title: Blue River Loop Xc Ski Trails
